name: Anbernic RG28XX
identify: helperFunctions.sh: cpuinfo CPU part "*0xd03*" (H700) -> reads BASEOS_TARGET from /etc/baseos-release; case "rg28xx" -> PLATFORM=AnbernicRG28XX

pad.note: A/B/X/Y, L1/R1, digital L2/R2, SELECT/START, MENU (plus its KEY_GOTO tap pulse), D-pad hat, stick axes and FF rumble, all on one event1 node (also enumerates as js0). Its EV_KEY bitmask also advertises KEY_ESC/KEY_VOLUMEDOWN/KEY_VOLUMEUP, but those three never actually fire on this node (controller-matrix C2 / RG28XX diagnostic capture).

vol.note: vendor's own typo for the node name, kept verbatim. KEY_VOLUMEUP 115 / KEY_VOLUMEDOWN 114 measured arriving here (not on event1) on RG34XX SP and RG40XX V by the NextUI port, and identified as the volume node in the RG28XX diagnostic capture (controller-matrix event2 entry; measured: the lab capturesAnbernicRG28XX-20260921.txt for this bucket's own node). On the RG28XX (2026-11-12) the volume keys came on ANBERNIC-keys, not here.

VOL_UP.note: on the RG28XX the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys (2026-11-12)

VOL_DOWN.note: on the RG28XX the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys (2026-11-12)

absent.L3: no analog stick on this bucket's hardware; cfg still exports B_L3="1 313" (shared AnbernicXXCommon.cfg), but the nostick SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_MAP (_XX_GC_NOSTICK) binds no button there (derived from AnbernicXXCommon.cfg + controller-matrix idx table).
absent.R3: no analog stick on this bucket's hardware; cfg still exports B_R3="1 316" (shared AnbernicXXCommon.cfg), but the nostick SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_MAP (_XX_GC_NOSTICK) binds no button there (derived from AnbernicXXCommon.cfg + controller-matrix idx table).
absent.LEFT_STICK: 0 sticks on this bucket (XX_PAD_LAYOUT="nostick" -> DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0 in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg)
absent.RIGHT_STICK: 0 sticks on this bucket (XX_PAD_LAYOUT="nostick" -> DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0 in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg)
absent.LID: no lid on any model in this bucket
absent.HOME: cfg B_HOME="DOESNT_EXIST"; MENU is spruce's home key on this line (matrix)
absent.FN_SWITCH: no latching Fn switch on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_LEFT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_RIGHT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)

notes: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME is computed at runtime in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg's BASEOS_TARGET case; rg28xx is not one of the named arms, so it falls to the default arm: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME="Anbernic RG28XX".

VOL_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/POWER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/CONTROLLER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH are exported in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg (event0/event2/event1) but nothing in the h700 tree reads them -- dead variables, not evidence for any control's source (grep of spruce/scripts at spruce_ref 0dccf5276b).

Display: 640x480 panel, DISPLAY_ROTATION=270 (native panel is 480x640 portrait, rotated for landscape use) (AnbernicRG28XX.cfg); does not affect face_print, which names physical button positions, not screen edges.

This model's WiFi is the line's one outlier (USB RTL8188EU instead of the SDIO RTL8821CS the rest of the bucket uses), per AnbernicRG28XX.cfg's WIFI_BUS/WIFI_MODULE block -- irrelevant to Button Reader but called out so it isn't mistaken for a different hardware family.
models are spruce's own SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME values (AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); Button Reader matches the unit's name against them
